operations.name: Update playlist items

This operation can be used for replacing or clear

insert_before.description: The position where the items should be inserted.To reorder the items to the end of the playlist, simply set _insert_before_ to the position after the last item.Examples:To reorder the first item to the last position in a playlist with 10 items, set _range_start_ to 0, and _insert_before_ to 10.To reorder the last item in a playlist with 10 items to the start of the playlist, set _range_start_ to 9

range_length.description: The amount of items to be reordered. Defaults to 1 if not set.The range of items to be reordered begins from the _range_start_ position, and includes the _range_length_ subsequent items.Example:To move the items at index 9-10 to the start of the playlist, _range_start_ is set to 9, and _range_length_ is set to 2.

range_start.description: The position of the first item to be reordered.

snapshot_id.description: The playlist's snapshot ID against which you want to make the changes.

operations.name: Seek to position

device_id.description: The id of the device this command is targeting. If not supplied, the user's currently active device is the target.

operations.description: Set the repeat mode for the user's playback. Options are repeat-track, repeat-context, and off.

state.description: **track**, **context** or **off**. **track** will repeat the current track. **context** will repeat the current context. **off** will turn repeat off.

device_id.description: The id of the device this command is targeting. If not supplied, the user's currently active device is the target.

operations.description: Start a new context or resume current playback on the user's active device.

device_id.description: The id of the device this command is targeting. If not supplied, the user's currently active device is the target.

context_uri.description: Optional. Spotify URI of the context to play. Valid contexts are albums, artists & playlists. `{context_uri:"spotify:album:1Je1IMUlBXcx1Fz0WE7oPT"}`

offset.description: Optional. Indicates from where in the context playback should start. Only available when context_uri corresponds to an album or playlist object "position" is zero based and can’t be negative. Example: `"offset": {"position": 5}` "uri" is a string representing the uri of the item to start at. Example: `"offset": {"uri": "spotify:track:1301WleyT98MSxVHPZCA6M"}`

uris.description: Optional. A JSON array of the Spotify track URIs to play. For example: `{"uris": ["spotify:track:4iV5W9uYEdYUVa79Axb7Rh", "spotify:track:1301WleyT98MSxVHPZCA6M"]}`

operations.name: Toggle playback shuffle

state.description: **true** : Shuffle user's playback. **false** : Do not shuffle user's playback.

device_id.description: The id of the device this command is targeting. If not supplied, the user's currently active device is the target.

device_ids.description: A JSON array containing the ID of the device on which playback should be started/transferred.For example:`{device_ids:["74ASZWbe4lXaubB36ztrGX"]}`_**Note**: Although an array is accepted, only a single device_id is currently supported. Supplying more than one will return `400 Bad Request`_

play.description: **true**: ensure playback happens on new device.**false** or not provided: keep the current playback state.

operations.name: Unfollow artists or users
operations.description: Remove the current user as a follower of one or more artists or other Spotify users.

ids.description: A JSON array of the artist or user [Spotify IDs](/documentation/web-api/#spotify-uris-and-ids). For example: `{ids:["74ASZWbe4lXaubB36ztrGX", "08td7MxkoHQkXnWAYD8d6Q"]}`. A maximum of 50 IDs can be sent in one request. _**Note**: if the `ids` parameter is present in the query string, any IDs listed here in the body will be ignored._

operations.name: Unfollow playlist
operations.description: Remove the current user as a follower of a playlist.

operations.name: Add custom playlist cover image
operations.description: Replace the image used to represent a specific playlist.
